mode: web-e2e (Playwright Chromium + WebKit, fresh Vite, VITE_E2E_MODE) + visual/code audit
summary: Fresh-Vite product audit passed 20/20 checks in Chromium and 20/20 in WebKit after the complete test-first microtypography migration. There was no blank screen, NaN, horizontal overflow, uncaught page error or unexpected console.error in portrait or landscape. All 112 production labels formerly sized 8-10.5 px now have a guarded minimum of 11 px. Personalization remains 11 single accents, while a concrete, privacy-safe three-palette plan is documented but not implemented.

orange.title: Avatar personalization is an accent picker, not a three-color palette system
orange.evidence: accent-theme.ts defines 11 independent accents and applies one hue to primary/ring/accent; avatar-accent.ts ranks existing accent IDs. The research plan now specifies Pulse, Forge and Glacier presets, a versioned data contract, local avatar proposal, lossless legacy migration and contrast/privacy acceptance tests, but runtime behavior has not changed.
orange.suggestion: Implement the documented PaletteThemeV2 in a separate test-first wave after release blockers, preserving every existing accent/custom hex until explicit user selection.

yellow.title: Some root routes repeat context in the top bar and page heading
yellow.suggestion: Keep one screen title and use the second line for context or an action in a post-blocker UX cleanup.
